summary: Python 3.14 introduces a new tail-calling interpreter as an opt-in feature, offering 3–5% better performance. It continues the Faster CPython initiative. The release follows the updated support policy: two years of full bug-fix support followed by three years of security fixes. OpenPGP signing was dropped for 3.14 in favor of Sigstore (PEP 761). Python 3.14 represents ongoing investment in interpreter performance and security.
notes: Receives full bug-fix and security support. Active support until 2027-10-01; security until 2030-10-31. Latest stable release as of early 2026.
